description: This file is a package metadata configuration for the Meteor.js framework, defining the bootstrap package, its assets, dependencies, and usage specifications.

methods.name: Package.describe
methods.description: Defines the package metadata, including name, summary, version, and repository.

methods.name: Package.onUse
methods.description: Sets up dependencies and assets for the package when it is used.

methods.name: api.versionsFrom
methods.description: Specifies the Meteor version from which to derive environment compatibility.

methods.name: api.use
methods.description: Specifies package dependencies required on client side.

methods.name: api.addAssets
methods.description: Adds asset files like fonts to the client, if supported.

methods.name: api.addFiles
methods.description: Includes JavaScript and CSS files into the package.
